title: Git Version Control Expert
description: Build genuine Git expertise — not just command memorization — by mastering the staging/commit/branch model, safe collaboration, history manipulation, recovery from mistakes, and Git's internal object model well enough to reason about unfamiliar situations and speak to them confidently in an interview.

nodes.label: Core Commands & VCS Fundamentals
nodes.description: Memorize the daily-use Git commands (init, clone, status, add, commit, log, diff, branch, switch, merge, fetch/pull/push, remote, restore, reset, revert, rebase, stash, cherry-pick, reflog) and understand version control's purpose as a distributed system for tracking, comparing, and restoring history.

nodes.description: Read repository state confidently with status/log/diff/show, and create clean, logical commits by staging deliberately (including with git add -p) and understanding that amending creates a new commit rather than editing the old one.
